description: This file contains utility functions for processing and redacting error and observation logs, including building error fingerprints, extracting request IDs, and preparing log fields for API errors and general text.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredRedactPatterns
methods.description: Retrieves and filters configured redact patterns from logging configuration.

methods.name: truncateForObservation
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum number of characters for observation logs.

methods.name: boundObservationInput
methods.description: Trims and bounds input text for observation, limiting to MAX_OBSERVATION_INPUT_CHARS.

methods.name: replaceRequestIdPreview
methods.description: Replaces request ID occurrences in text with a redacted version.

methods.name: redactObservationText
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from observation logs using configured patterns.

methods.name: extractRequestId
methods.description: Extracts request ID from text using regex.

methods.name: buildObservationFingerprint
methods.description: Builds a fingerprint string for an observation based on provided parameters.

methods.name: buildApiErrorObservationFields
methods.description: Generates observation fields from raw API error string, including redaction and fingerprinting.

methods.name: buildTextObservationFields
methods.description: Generates observation fields from general text, utilizing API error processing.
